text: The current folder filter uses strict > after and < before comparisons, but activates each bound with a truthiness check. A Date at epoch zero therefore produces a bound that the filter ignores. The existing tests place timestamps inside ranges rather than exactly on a boundary. Recommend equality and epoch-zero tests before changing this contract. This is a static concern, with no failed query reproduced; schema minimum/maximum prose should be checked against intended inclusivity in discussion. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.
title: Check exact folder date boundaries and zero-valued bounds explicitly
